SYNTHETIC mechanism-validation fixture: an indefinite-retention host under UK jurisdiction. r_RET (the real, correct rule) only guards J=='EU', so this host is uncontested for r_RET_BAD (guard: J in EU,UK), which is admitted only under --CPA (rejected as a non-joinable critical pair against r_RET under the full pipeline, since both match the identical RetentionClause+DurationIndefinite pattern -- see r_RET_BAD's docstring in library.py). This is what makes 'CPA does measurable work' visible in Table 7a: full pipeline leaves this host with no applicable rule (0 steps, a real coverage gap outside this fixture's scope), while --CPA's admitted r_RET_BAD fires and wrongly deletes the indefinite-duration node instead of bounding it (1 step). Repeated across several ages (probe_002..005) rather than once, so the effect has enough weight to move the aggregate median/repair-success columns, not just the per-host trace -- one instance is real but statistically invisible in a small aggregate. Not used for Table 7b.
